newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine bonds end up, look to U.S. rates.
newsitem.headline: Argentine bonds end up, look to U.S. rates.

text.p: Argentine bonds finished higher Thursday, following slight gains by U.S. Treasuries but with most players predicting the market will have no clear trend until the U.S. Federal Open Market Committee May 20.
"The market is waiting" for the outcome of the meeting to see if there will be any hike in U.S. rates, said a trader at a foreign bank.
Argentina's FRB Brady bond due 2005 was up 1/4 at 92-3/8, while the dollar-denominated Bocon Previsional 4 due 2002 was up $0.05 at 115.15.
